name: codex-usage-card
description: A resizable Windows desktop usage card and local Codex skill for remaining plan limits.

interface.longDescription: Read your remaining Codex plan limits and reset times, or open a resizable Cosmic desktop card with automatic refresh and opt-in Windows startup. Uses the installed, signed-in Codex CLI. Requires Python 3.11+ with Tk. Local skills plugin; no hosted service.
